title: A surjection whose kernel has an inner inverse admits a section
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and let F,G,M be R-modules with underlying additive commutative groups. Let f:G→F, g:F→G, and π:F→M be R-linear maps. Assume (f∘g)∘f=f, π is surjective, and ker π=im f. Then there exists an R-linear map s:M→F with π∘s=id_M. No freeness, finiteness, or nontriviality assumptions are required.
lean_statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {F : Type*} [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Module R G] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (f : G →ₗ[R] F) (g : F →ₗ[R] G) (π : F →ₗ[R] M) (_hinner : (f.comp g).comp f = f) (_hπ : Function.Surjective π) (_hker : LinearMap.ker π = LinearMap.range f), ∃ s : M →ₗ[R] F, π.comp s = LinearMap.id
